_comment: Stage 2F voice-eval baseline. Tolerances are the regression gate (spec Component 5). VALUES are the observed run on this single-operator lab corpus (2026-05-30). Update ONLY on an approved intentional change, never to mask a regression.

idle_false_fires.gate: informational — nuisance, not a hazard; track for regressions

wake_tpr_single_operator_ceiling.gate: informational only — optimistic ceiling, NOT robustness (C4)

far_per_hour_ci_upper.gate: UNMEASURABLE on minutes-long corpus; the 273/hr CI upper reflects 0.011h of negatives, NOT a real FAR. A <=1/hr gate needs >=3h zero-fire negatives (C3).
